caption: The drawing consists of a large, nearly square grid centered on a beige or light tan background. The grid is defined by thin, hand-drawn lines in pencil or graphite, with two main vertical divisions creating two rectangular sections side by side. Each section is further divided into several horizontal bands by evenly spaced, straight lines. Along the far left side of the grid, there are small colored marks—red, yellow, blue, and green—interspersed at regular intervals, but these color marks only appear on this edge and are not present elsewhere in the grid. The interior of the grid is filled with tightly grouped, parallel pencil lines and shorter hatch marks, forming horizontal bands of varying densities. Near the bottom left of the image, the words “Work Chart” are written in cursive by hand, and the name "Cotton" is lightly inscribed just above this. The overall composition is precise, repetitive, and organized, with the marks and colors remaining confined to the left margin of the main grid.
title: Textile
